title: Eliminator 500 SE Cruiser (Adventure Spec)
description: The Kawasaki Eliminator 500 SE Cruiser (Adventure Spec) is engineered for uncompromised trans-continental exploration, positioned in the Performance Cruiser segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 500cc engine generating 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 163 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
